keyCapabilities.title: Built for Every Indian Farmer
keyCapabilities.subtext: Combining artificial intelligence with ground-level agricultural expertise to protect crops and boost yields.
keyCapabilities.f1Desc: Submit questions through voice notes, plant leaf photos, or text messages in your local language.
keyCapabilities.f2Desc: Upload a photo of damaged leaves for computer vision identification of pests, blights, and deficiencies.
keyCapabilities.f3Desc: Trained on ICAR guidelines, state agriculture university data, and regional soil health reports.
keyCapabilities.f4Desc: When AI confidence falls below 80%, your query automatically routes to local extension officers.
keyCapabilities.f5Desc: Check eligibility for PM-KISAN installments, PM-KUSUM solar pumps, and fertilizer subsidies.

howItWorks.title: How Krishi Sathi Advisory Works
howItWorks.subtext: From voice input to verified treatment plans, our platform ensures every farmer gets accurate guidance.
howItWorks.s1Desc: Speak into your microphone, upload a leaf picture, or type a query in your native dialect.
howItWorks.s2Desc: AI scans disease symptoms, checks local weather forecasts, and cross-references ICAR research.
howItWorks.s3Desc: Get exact chemical/organic dosages, preventative spray timings, and safety measures.
howItWorks.s4Desc: Complex cases automatically alert local Krishi Vigyan Kendra officers for human verification.

whyUs.title: Empowering Farmers with Technology & Trust
whyUs.subtext: Designed specifically for smallholder and commercial farmers across India's diverse agro-climatic zones.
whyUs.c1Desc: No need to wait days for office visits. Get instant crop diagnostics anytime day or night.
whyUs.c2Desc: Recommendations account for humidity forecasts, rain predictions, and local soil types.
whyUs.c3Desc: Built to serve the agricultural community with no hidden fees or commercial product push.
whyUs.c4Desc: Full voice and text support in English, Hindi, Marathi, and Malayalam with simple agricultural terminology.
